segments.title: A giant planet STOPPED crossing its star. Why?
segments.say: A giant planet stopped crossing its star. Why? It exploded, its star ate it, or a hidden planet? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: A hidden planet tilted it!
segments.say: A hidden planet tilted its orbit. It's still there!

segments.title: Meet TOI-2535 b
segments.say: It's a Jupiter-sized planet, about a thousand light-years away.

segments.title: NASA's TESS watched 7 years
segments.say: NASA's TESS telescope watched it cross for seven years. Then it vanished.

segments.title: The culprit: Saturn-mass
segments.say: The likely culprit: an unseen neighbor, about as heavy as Saturn.
Follow for Guess It number 27 tomorrow.
